summary: Frontend retest after main agent applied useFocusEffect + useRootNavigationState guards to tab screens, router.back() fallback in add.tsx screens, and <title> tag in +html.tsx. Critical balance-refresh bug is FIXED: dashboard Total Net Worth now reflects ₹15,000 (was stale at ₹10,000 last iteration) and TEST_HDFC account card shows ₹15,000 on return from add-income flow. No 'Attempted to navigate before mounting' red error observed on direct preview URL load. No 'GO_BACK was not handled' warnings. Code review confirms sub_category chips (formatINR.ts subs arrays) and FamilyMemberPicker+'For whom?' label are wired in transactions/add.tsx. REMAINING ISSUES: (1) Browser tab title is still EMPTY at runtime — +html.tsx <title> only applies to expo export/static build, not dev server; needs runtime document.title (e.g., in _layout.tsx useEffect). (2) 'Unexpected text node: .' React warning still fires 3x per Add Transaction open — stray '.' literal inside a <View> somewhere in transactions/add.tsx. (3) In-app bottom nav labels are 'Home/Transactions/Accounts/Hub/Profile' not 'Dashboard' — minor naming inconsistency vs spec.

ui_bugs.issue: Browser tab title is empty (document.title === '') at runtime despite <title>Fintracker ...</title> in +html.tsx. Expo Router dev server serves its own HTML template and does not pick up +html.tsx until static export. Set document.title from app/_layout.tsx via useEffect or add a <Head> component.

Console error 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' logs 3x on form open/interaction. Stray '.' literal rendered as text node inside a <View>. Search for {' . '} or {condition && '.'} patterns.

issues: Tab labels say 'Home' instead of 'Dashboard' (minor; spec uses 'Dashboard').

action_items: Set document.title at runtime from app/_layout.tsx useEffect (e.g., if (Platform.OS === 'web') document.title = 'Fintracker – Personal Finance & Wealth Management'). +html.tsx alone does not set title for dev server.
Fix stray text node '.' in app/transactions/add.tsx (likely a conditional rendering a bare '.' string inside a View).
Optional: rename 'Home' tab label to 'Dashboard' in (tabs)/_layout.tsx for naming consistency.

Sub_category chips and FamilyMemberPicker are present in code; consider adding data-testid on category chips and sub-category chips so automated test can select them without colliding with recent-transaction source text.
critical_code_review_comments: useFocusEffect + useRootNavigationState guard pattern is correctly implemented across all four tab screens + analytics.tsx. Refresh-on-focus confirmed working end-to-end.
router.back() fallback via canGoBack() is correctly in place in transactions/add.tsx and accounts/add.tsx.
transactions/add.tsx correctly gates sub_category chips behind a (subs.length === 0) early return, so only Salary/Food/etc. categories with defined subs[] arrays expose sub picker. Good pattern.
FamilyMemberPicker is always rendered but may appear visually empty if the single-user has zero family members — consider showing an 'Add a family member' inline hint when members list is empty.

rca of the issue: Previous iteration's critical balance-staleness bug had RCA: dashboard/accounts tab did not re-invoke loadAll() on navigation return. Main agent's fix adds useFocusEffect(useCallback(loadAll)) to all four tab screens + analytics. Verified: NW jumped from last-known ₹10,000 to ₹15,000 after reopening tab. Root-layout race was fixed by gating useEffect with `if (!navState?.key) return;` — verified no red overlay on direct refresh. router.back() race fixed by canGoBack() check. All three fixes are effective.
